topic: VR Based training module on various aircraft
syllabus_extract: VR Based training module on various aircraft.
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee should be able to practical on various lab FTL, RF & Embedded lab.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Operate VR module for FTL, RF & Embedded labs; Observe safety protocols; Instructor supervises simulation execution.
intro_questions: What are the three primary laboratory domains covered in this module?
Why is VR training preferred over traditional methods for these labs?
List two safety precautions required before starting VR simulation.

topics: Introduction to FTL Lab VR Module
development.content:
Introduction to FTL Lab VR Module
System initialization and safety checks
Basic flight dynamics simulation
Instrument panel interaction
Emergency procedure simulation

RF Lab VR Module Overview
Antenna radiation pattern visualization
Signal propagation simulation
Interference analysis tools
Data logging and interpretation

Embedded Lab VR Module Introduction
Circuit board virtual assembly
Sensor integration simulation
Debugging virtual code errors
System performance testing

summary_questions: Explain the difference between FTL and Embedded lab simulations.
How does the VR module assist in visualizing RF radiation patterns?
What steps are taken to ensure safety during VR lab operations?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on how the VR module concepts learned today will assist in operating the antenna trainer described in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: By using antenna trainer, observe, measure output and radiation pattern on following antenna: - Half wave simple dipole antenna, Quarter wave simple dipole antenna & Half wave folded dipole with reflector antenna.
